text: E ko tuma nde musiiba fooleede nden heɓunoo on onon muumini en ñande uhud, woɗɓe e mo'on waraa ; gomɗii le on heɓniino ayɓe mon ɓen cowalle mun immorde e waraaɓe dahaa ñalnde badri, wi'uɗon: "Hol no men heɓiri ɗum ko men gomɗimɓe, meɗen wonndi e Annabiijo Alla on?!" Maaku an Annabiijo: "Ko sabu pooɗondiral mon ngal yedda Nulaaɗo on heɓirɗon ɗum", pellet, Alla ko Haɗtanɗo kala huunde Himo Walla on Mo O Muuyi, O Hoyna on Mo O Muuyi.
